mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hypervisor_resource( hypervisor_id, status, availability_zone, traits, total_vcpu, total_memory_mb, total_gpu, resource_version, updated_at) VALUES (#{hypervisorId}, 'ACTIVE', #{availabilityZone}, '[]', #{totalVcpu}, #{totalMemoryMb}, #{totalGpu}, #{version}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE availability_zone = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(availability_zone), availability_zone), total_vcpu = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(total_vcpu), total_vcpu), total_memory_mb = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(total_memory_mb), total_memory_mb), total_gpu = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(total_gpu), total_gpu), updated_at = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(updated_at), updated_at), resource_version = GREATEST(resource_version, VALUES(resource_version))

INSERT INTO hypervisor_gpu( hypervisor_id, gpu_id, model, traits, assignment_status, resource_version, updated_at) VALUES (#{hypervisorId}, #{gpuId}, #{model}, #{traits}, 'AVAILABLE', #{version}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE model = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(model), model), traits = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(traits), traits), updated_at = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(updated_at), updated_at), resource_version = GREATEST(resource_version, VALUES(resource_version))
mapper.update: UPDATE hypervisor_resource SET reserved_vcpu = reserved_vcpu + #{reservedVcpuDelta}, allocated_vcpu = allocated_vcpu + #{allocatedVcpuDelta}, reserved_memory_mb = reserved_memory_mb + #{reservedMemoryMbDelta}, allocated_memory_mb = allocated_memory_mb + #{allocatedMemoryMbDelta}, reserved_gpu = reserved_gpu + #{reservedGpuDelta}, allocated_gpu = allocated_gpu + #{allocatedGpuDelta}, resource_version = #{version}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE hypervisor_id = #{hypervisorId} AND resource_version < #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO instance_allocation( instance_id, hypervisor_id, reservation_id, vcpus, memory_mb, gpu_count, allocation_status, resource_version, updated_at) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{hypervisorId}, #{reservationId}, #{vcpus}, #{memoryMb}, #{gpuCount}, 'ALLOCATED', #{version}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE allocation_status = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), 'ALLOCATED', allocation_status), updated_at = IF(resource_version < VALUES(resource_version), VALUES(updated_at), updated_at), resource_version = GREATEST(resource_version, VALUES(resource_version))
